Weekly Active Users

This chart extends the weekly active user trend through the third quarter, pulled from the same analytics warehouse view used in the last update. Growth held through the summer months, with a brief dip in August around the planned maintenance window.

Overall, the trend line supports continuing investment in onboarding rather than paid acquisition for the next two quarters, since organic activation is outpacing spend efficiency.

The August dip appears fully explained by the maintenance window and has already reversed in early September, so no change to the current roadmap is recommended.
